title: Case 015: Front Door Repair Request
initial_request: The front door feels stuck making it difficult to open and close. It stucks at the base but there's no item beneath preventing it from closing or opening which i have checked.
overview: The tenant reported that the front door was sticking at the base and difficult to open or close, with no obstruction found. Northbridge Lettings contacted the landlord, who approved an inspection. A maintenance provider was assigned, and the door was later reported as repaired. The provider also noted that the door was starting to rot and swell, so the issue could recur, and recommended a modern replacement. An attachment-60-document was received and added to the case; its PDF contents are unavailable.
outcome: The agency confirmed that the door had been adjusted and warned the landlord that swelling could cause the issue to recur and that replacement may be needed.
